disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. This key covers PNB Visa Platinum and PNB RuPay Platinum, including Wave n Pay Global Platinum packaging. It is not Luxura.

annual.summary: Visa Platinum and RuPay Platinum list an annual fee of ₹500. Visa Platinum add-on cards are ₹500 each.

annual_waiver.summary: RuPay Platinum waives the annual fee if the card is used at least once each quarter in the previous year. The Visa Platinum waiver row in the PDF is fragmented, so do not invent a spend threshold for Visa Platinum.

forex.summary: Foreign-currency markup is 3.5 percent over the network conversion rate for non-Luxura cards including Visa and RuPay Platinum.

fuel_surcharge.summary: PNB MITC describes a 1 percent fuel surcharge waiver on eligible fuel transactions with caps that vary by card variant; Platinum-specific bands were not isolated in the extract.

base_earn.summary: Visa Platinum earns 2 reward points per ₹150 spent. RuPay Platinum earns 1 reward point per ₹100 spent.

redemption.summary: Redeem from 1,000 points via 1800-572-9500, creditcard.pnb.bank.in, or support@pnbrewardz.com. Points forfeit on closure or delinquency. ₹0.25 per point is cited only in a negative-balance closure example.
